content.text:
We need to choose 2 units to destroy. Options: 2 ships in Port of Pyke (7,8), footman 9, knights 6 and 37 in Greywater Watch.

Greywater Watch has knight 6, knight 37, footman 9. We control greywater-watch with those units. We should preserve land units for holding castles. But Greywater Watch has no castle. Hmm. Our castles: we have 4 castle areas - pyke (stronghold), seagard (castle), moat-cailin (castle), flints-finger (castle). Wait controlledRegions: pyke, port-of-pyke, seagard, flints-finger, greywater-watch, moat-cailin. Pyke is a stronghold (castle=2), seagard castle=2, moat-cailin castle=1, flints-finger castle=1. Those are 4 castle areas. Seagard, flints-finger, moat-cailin have no units currently (only power tokens). Greywater-watch has our army (2 knights + 1 footman). So we need to preserve this army to defend/attack.

We should destroy 2 ships in port? Port ships don't provide transport, only useful for future mustering/mobility. Ships in port can be used to move into Ironman's Bay for transport. But Ironman's Bay currently contains no units. We have power 9.

Given land units matter for holding castles, we want to keep land army. Destroying 2 ships (7,8) leaves fleet empty but keeps land army. But losing both ships removes naval capability. Alternatively destroy one ship and the footman (9). Footman is weakest land unit, but it's part of the army.

The army at greywater-watch: 2 knights (2 strength each) + footman (1) = 5 strength. Destroying footman reduces land strength but keeps knights. Greywater watch has no castle, but it's a buffer/defensive position adjacent to flints-finger (our castle) and moat-cailin (our castle). Actually greywater-watch neighbors: bay-of-ice, flints-finger, ironmans-bay, moat-cailin, seagard. So it's adjacent to three of our castles! Keeping army there protects them and can support.

Ships in port-of-pyke are safe from attack (ports can't be attacked directly). They are not doing anything. But if we destroy both, later we may need ships. However we have du... Hmm.

Priority: preserve ability to hold and capture castle areas. Land units occupy land castles. So keep land units. Destroy 2 ships (7,8). That leaves us with no ships at all? We had ship 8 move to port of pyke in round 7. We have ships 7,8 only. Destroying both leaves no ships. Ironman's Bay empty, so we could muster later. But supply 3.

Alternative: destroy 1 ship and footman. Keeps 1 ship for transport and 2 knights. But knights can't take land castles alone? Knights do occupy land castles. Land units = knights. We have 2 knights anyway.

Actually preserving military strength: destroying footman (1 str) loses less than destroying 2 ships (1 str each = 2 str, but ships are in port not contributing to land defense). However, ships provide future mobility. Hmm.

But the decision says "Choose losses that preserve your ability to hold and capture castle areas." Since we can't easily rebuild ships without mustering, but mustering can place ships in adjacent sea. Ships in port are replaceable via mustering.

Land army is harder to replace and more valuable. Destroy 2 ships.

Let me verify no upcoming threats - actually we're in the middle of wildlings-attack resolution. After this, probably continue to action phase. Round 8. We have 4 castles, need 7 to win. We're at 4 VP. Martell 4, Lannister 4. We need to expand to capture more castles. Nearby castles: The Eyrie (6 garrison neutral), crackclaw-point (lannister, 3 footmen), harrenhal (lannister 1 footman), lannisport (lannister, 2 footmen + garrison 2), Winterfell (stark, empty but garrison 2), White Harbor (stark, castle=1, empty), The Twins (crown1 no castle), Moat Cailin we own.

To capture castles we need land units. So preserving knights is key.

Destroy 7 and 8 (ships). That keeps army intact.

But wait - could destroy 9 footman to keep a ship for transport, enabling our knights to reach islands or across seas? Transport requires ships in connecting sea areas. Ships in a port do not provide transport. So ship in port doesn't help transport unless moved to Ironman's Bay. We could later move it. But we could also muster ships.

Given we want to keep knights to take castles, and footman too. I'll destroy the two ships.

Actually let me reconsider: destroying both ships means zero naval presence. An opponent could take Ironman's Bay and threaten Pyke. Baratheon has 2 ships in shipbreaker bay, martell 1 in east summer sea, stark 1 in narrow sea and bay of ice, tyrell 1 in redwyne. Lannister 1 in golden sound. None near Ironman's Bay currently. So safe.

Also we have power tokens to establish control and could muster.

Final: destroy unit_ids 7 and 8.

Let me maybe check neighbours to confirm, but observation already gives info. I think it's fine. Let me quickly check greywater-watch neighbours to confirm strategic value.

Actually the observation already lists. I'll just decide. But instructions encourage exploration. I can do one check_neighbours for greywater-watch and ironmans-bay. Not strictly needed. Let me just do it to be safe and thorough.

I'll make a tool call.
